findings.claim: FY2024 10-K：沒有單一商家在任一報告期間占總營收超過 5%
findings.excerpt: Our merchants represent a wide array of retail verticals and business sizes and no single merchant has ever represented more than five percent of our total revenues in a single reporting period.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：因商家基礎多元，應收款、貸款、商家現金墊款無特定信用風險集中
findings.excerpt: Due to the Company’s diversified merchant base, there is no particular concentration of credit risk related to the Company’s trade and other receivables, loans receivable and merchant cash advances.
